response.text:
I can’t open attachments or access the report without the file — and you noted no PDF/web tools are available. I’m not able to produce page-level citations until you provide the annual report pages or the PDF.

What I can do next — pick one:
- You upload the PDF here (or paste the text of relevant pages). I will extract every emissions target, quote the exact wording, and list page-level citations (page number + short quote) plus a 1–2 line summary of scope, baseline year, target year, % reduction (if given), and any notes on verification/standards.
- If you prefer to do it yourself, I can give precise search guidance and a citation template you can use to capture targets quickly.

Quick guidance and search terms to find emissions targets in an annual report:
- Search for keywords: “emissions”, “GHG”, “greenhouse gas”, “Scope 1”, “Scope 2”, “Scope 3”, “carbon”, “net zero”, “carbon neutral”, “science-based targets”, “SBTi”, “climate target”, “reduction target”, “baseline year”, “target year”, “decarbonisation”.
- Likely locations: Sustainability/ESG section, CEO/Chair letter, Strategy section, Risk/TCFD/climate disclosures, Metrics & Targets table, GRI/CDP/SASB/TCFD appendices.
- When you find a statement, note: exact wording, page number, whether it cites scope (1/2/3), baseline year, target year, % or absolute reductions, third‑party validation (e.g., SBTi), and any related metrics (e.g., interim targets).

If you upload the file or paste pages now, I’ll produce the page-level citations and a concise summary as described. Which would you like to do?
